Aromatic Bliss.descriptor: Inhale the calm. Exhale the chaos of that last email.
The perfect temperature to warm your hands and your soul.
This is your moment of Zen. Do not let a meeting interrupt it.
The tea bag has fulfilled its noble destiny. Respect.
Smells like productivity and a hint of bergamot.

Sippable Serenity.descriptor: The ideal temperature to solve all of today's problems.
Still radiating a pleasant, cozy warmth.
This is the golden hour for tea. Enjoy it.
No longer a threat to your taste buds. Sip away.
It’s perfect now. Don't you dare get distracted and forget about it.

Tepid Tranquility.descriptor: It's lost the will to be warm. It's just... room temperature now.
It whispers tales of a time when it was hot and full of promise.
It's the temperature of a mild disappointment.
To reheat or not to reheat? That is the question.
You got distracted by a cat video on the internet, didn't you?

Cold Comfort.descriptor: A tribute to a meeting that ran entirely too long.
Congratulations, you've made sad, cold leaf water.
Your mug is now a monument to your short attention span.
It's now officially 'iced tea' if you're an optimist.
Just pour it into the office plant. It's seen worse.

Tannin Stain Terror.descriptor: This mug will now forever remember the tea it once held.
A dark ring has formed. It's a portal to the land of forgotten beverages.
You're not just washing this mug; you're excavating it.
The cleaning crew will leave you a strongly worded, passive-aggressive note.
It's developing its own microscopic ecosystem in there.
